criterionOutcomes.criterion: Reopening Display Settings for the same Surveyor layer shows the changed Show linked sites checkbox state without adding the layer again.
criterionOutcomes.reason: This criterion's ordered screenshots and steps show checked, toggled unchecked, settings closed, and reopened unchecked for Surveyor - Service, with the same layer and legend retained and no intervening add-layer action.
